items.name: AMAP-ML/LongHorizon-Harness
items.summary: The long-horizon computer-use harness. Run AI agents across desktop apps and the CLI for extended periods while preserving task state and making reliable progress on complex workflows. Features fresh-context execution, durable verified state, independent auditing, recoverable progress, and native Claude Code / Codex / OpenClaw integration.
